payload.title: Fix living-report text media types for artifact tickets
payload.description:
The living-report publisher declares text artifact content types with charset parameters, but the existing artifact-ticket contract accepts only a type and subtype. Real task-attachment ticket creation therefore rejects Markdown and CSV artifacts even though local fake-store tests pass.

Feature: Publish text artifacts through the production ticket contract

Scenario: Upload Markdown and CSV task attachments
Given a living report publishes scorecard text artifacts
When it requests existing task-attachment write tickets
Then Markdown uses text/markdown
And CSV uses text/csv
And the ticket contract accepts both requests

Scenario: Keep character encoding deterministic
Given a text artifact omits a charset media-type parameter
When it is decoded
Then Markdown remains UTF-8
And CSV remains UTF-8 with its existing spreadsheet-compatible byte-order marker
